display_long_description:
Lever patterns to match the actual machine, for professionals and aspiring professionals.
With four patterns to choose from (JIS, Hitachi Komatsu, Mitsubishi, and Shinko), you can select the one that matches the type of actual operation or the type you are familiar with.

◆Recommended for the following people
For those who are not familiar with excavator operation.
For simulation before operating the actual machine
For training of technical intern trainees.
For heavy equipment geeks who really want to touch the actual equipment.

◆Training Contents
(1) Stage 1: Excavation and loading at construction site
(2) Stage 2: Excavation and loading at road construction　
(3) Stage 3: Transportation in mountain forest
(4) Stage 4: Driving training

◆Leverage pattern
　Selectable from 4 patterns (JIS pattern, Hitachi/Komatsu pattern, Mitsubishi pattern, Shinko pattern)

◆Language
Language can be selected from Japanese or English.

◆Speed setting
The following speeds can be set
Crawler
Crawler
Crawler ・Turning
Boom
Bucket/Grapple open/close
Grapple open/close
Grapple back and forth
Grapple swivel

◆Verified Terminals 
MetaQuest2 , MetaQuest3 , MetaQuest3s
